title: Tantei wa mou, Shindeiru. Season 2

thread.title: The Detective is Already Dead Season 2 • Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. Season 2 - Episode 1 discussion

opinions.point: Some viewers thought the premiere was better than expected and expressed hope for the season, especially readers familiar with the light novels.
Several commenters still liked particular characters, especially Nagisa and Siesta, while acknowledging that the broader story can be messy or confusing.
A number of viewers were strongly critical of the franchise, describing the prior season as disappointing, convoluted, or lacking compelling character and writing quality.
Some viewers were cautiously willing to continue watching despite poor memories of the first season, while others questioned why the show received another season.
Reactions to the episode's structure were divided, with comments suggesting the opening spent a long time on mourning before becoming unusually hectic near the end.
